name: netbox_api_call
description: Call the NetBox REST API (DCIM/IPAM source of truth). Blast radius: GET=low, POST/PUT/PATCH=medium (create/modify), DELETE=destructive. Rooted at the configured URL; pass paths under /api/...

function.name: netbox_api_call
function.description:
Call the NetBox REST API (rooted at the configured instance URL). Token auth is already configured — do NOT use requests.

RETURN VALUE: a JSON string; json.loads it -> {"status_code", "data", "error", "blast_radius"}. Check status_code < 400 before trusting data.

LIST SHAPE & PAGING: list endpoints wrap rows under data["results"] with data["count"] total and data["next"] (URL). Filter/paginate with query_params, e.g. {"site": "nyc", "status": "active", "limit": 100, "offset": 0}. Trailing slash on collection paths is required.

DCIM (inventory):
  GET    /api/dcim/devices/                 List devices (low)
  GET    /api/dcim/devices/{id}/            Device detail (low)
  POST   /api/dcim/devices/                 Create device (medium)
  PATCH  /api/dcim/devices/{id}/            Update fields (medium)
  DELETE /api/dcim/devices/{id}/            Delete device (destructive)
  GET    /api/dcim/sites/                   List sites (low)
  GET    /api/dcim/racks/                   List racks (low)
  GET    /api/dcim/interfaces/?device_id={id}  Interfaces on a device (low)

IPAM (addressing):
  GET    /api/ipam/ip-addresses/            List IPs (low)
  GET    /api/ipam/prefixes/                List prefixes (low)
  GET    /api/ipam/prefixes/{id}/available-ips/  Free IPs in a prefix (low)
  GET    /api/ipam/vlans/                   List VLANs (low)
  POST   /api/ipam/ip-addresses/            Allocate an IP (medium)
    Body: {"address": "10.1.1.5/24", "status": "active", "dns_name": "..."}

OTHER:
  GET /api/status/                          Instance status (validates token) (low)
  GET /api/extras/config-contexts/          Config contexts (low)

BLAST RADIUS: GET=low (auto). Writes (POST/PATCH/PUT=medium, DELETE=destructive) pause for approval — describe the exact record + fields before writing. On 401/403 the token is wrong or lacks permission.

path.description: API endpoint path with trailing slash for collections (e.g., '/api/dcim/devices/')
